scope_limits: T01–T13 map to the synthetic subcases listed in the accompanying evidence MD, not every real-world scenario.
T14 real-X/W0, physical phones, real account transitions, power/battery behavior and chat-app receipt remain NOT RUN; live adapters stay disabled.

The existing real-low-space external driver primarily verifies media admission and Archive/completed-file canaries. Buffer admission at an actually filled filesystem below its small reserve was not separately exercised.

T08 includes actual OS process stop/reboot/upgrade after Archive commit before buffer acknowledgement. The pre-commit rollback guard is modeled in native SQLite tests; no claim of a separate OS kill before Archive commit.
Logical expiry and actual GC/reclamation are distinct; no exact-time physical or secure erasure guarantee during sleep/force-stop.
Job-local debug signing and fixed synthetic old-APK upgrades are not production-key upgrades or migration of real personal data.
Software TCG results remain independent FAIL evidence and are not combined with these accelerated CI results.
